headline: Cleverbridge says a third party copied stored payment card data; a customer notice says it included the CVV.
summary: First build from Cleverbridge's own incident page (Tier 1, read Nov 22), BleepingComputer (Tier 2) and a Malwarebytes forum reply (Tier 4). c001 theft of card data, c002, c003, c005 Confirmed on the company page; the one-source rule is met by the company page, not by BleepingComputer alone. c004 card number, expiry and CVV Reported (one outlet quoting a notice). c006 to c008 Reported. Count, affected businesses, method and attacker Not established. Privacy check done: no reporters, staff or contacts named.
author: Research agent
